description: Plain sleeve bearing with a collar: a cylindrical sleeve (bore d, wall s, length L) with a wider collar/flange at one end, an internal circumferential oil groove fed by a radial lubrication cross-hole (medium/hard), and a lead-in chamfer on the open rim (hard). Wall, length, collar and lube features scale with the bore.
source: norelem 23761 datasheet (plain bearing sintered bronze with collar, 61 articles over the bore series); no ISO/DIN number on the sheet, so the wall/length/collar proportions are declared as proportion (ISO 3547 / DIN 1850 wrapped-bushing style)
